title: Reading the Unreadable: Text-Aware Image Super-Resolution Needs Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.15449v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-aware image super-resolution (TAISR) aims to recover high-resolution images from low-resolution inputs while preserving textual content. Existing methods treat this as a visual restoration problem, yet severely degraded text often cannot be read from local visual evidence alone. Humans instead read it by reasoning over image context, logical patterns, and prior knowledge. This raises a fundamental question: Does TAISR need reasoning? To answer this, we introduce two diagnostic tools. The first, ReasonText, is a human-curated benchmark that separates reasoning-required text from locally recoverable text. The second, Ground-Truth Text-Crop Accuracy (GTTCA), is a recognition-based metric that measures text restoration quality without text detection errors. translated_title: 读取不可读之物：文本感知图像超分辨率需要推理
translated_abstract: 文本感知图像超分辨率（TAISR）旨在从低分辨率输入中恢复高分辨率图像，同时保留文本内容。现有方法将此视为一个视觉复原问题，然而严重退化的文本往往无法仅凭局部视觉证据来读取。人类则通过推理图像上下文、逻辑模式和先验知识来读取这些文本。这引出了一个根本性问题：TAISR是否需要推理？为了回答这个问题，我们引入了两种诊断工具。第一种是ReasonText，这是一个由人工策划的基准数据集，用于区分需要推理的文本与可局部恢复的文本。第二种是真实文本裁剪准确率（GTTCA），这是一种基于识别的指标，可以在没有文本检测错误的情况下测量文本复原质量。通过对十二个近期超分辨率（SR）模型的评估，我们发现模型在需要推理的文本上存在一致且显著的性能下降，揭示了一个系统性盲点。
tldr: 本文提出ReasonText基准和GTTCA评估指标两项诊断工具，揭示现有超分辨率模型在需要推理的严重退化文本上存在系统性性能盲点，证明文本感知图像超分辨率需要超越局部视觉证据的推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces two diagnostic tools, the ReasonText benchmark and the GTTCA metric, revealing a systematic blind spot of existing super-resolution models on reasoning-required text and demonstrating that text-aware image super-resolution needs reasoning beyond local visual evidence.
